post.summary: Explicit player use; no simulated-NPC reputation
post.description: JSON only. Existing bearer identity for private operations. 120 requests/minute/IP; construction additionally 12 writes/minute/user. No general analytics events. Server catalog, prerequisites, costs, terrain and permissions are authoritative. Reputation signals require a different, contacted account aged at least seven days; once per account/object. No foreign modification rights are enabled.

Same collector as the website's own /api/track: one allow-list of event types, one table, one 400-day sweep. Always answers 204 and never tells the client anything; unknown event types are dropped silently. Bot traffic is discarded server-side by user agent. Sent with navigator.sendBeacon.

title.description: Localized description of the sheet; the artwork itself has no language

image.description: Full-size AVIF master, for viewing and printing

thumb.description: 300px AVIF variant for grids; falls back to the master when absent

User.description: Public contributor identity; no private fields

Thread.description: Existing private guardian-thread DTO; may include reclaim/publication hints owned by the website

GameParcel.description: Only registered stock/variants and per-kind counts from the installed game-contract.json. Half-tile grid, space bounds, non-overlapping solids, protected dock/path/door and verified access. No HTML, URLs, uploads or arbitrary assets.

GameState.description: Private bounded snapshot, not server-attested progression or website money. Allowed keys, item caps, balance cap and scene coordinates are validated against the installed data contract. Timestamps in milliseconds. Never public.

GameSave.description: New: profileId=null, baseRevision=0. Later: last acknowledged ID/revision. Retry identical payload/operationId until acknowledged. A built parcel cannot become null through autosave.

GameSaveResponse.description: Last 16 receipts retained. A late replay returns current profile and original acknowledgedRevision; differing revisions require conflict resolution.

progress.description: Server-owned flags, timers and one-time reward receipts.

resources.description: Region renewal cycles and compact collected-node hex bitsets.

object.description: place: kind,variant,x,y,rotation. move: id,revision,x,y,rotation. remove: id,revision. Catalog identity is immutable after placement.

device_id.description: UUID from magikito.discovery, shared with the website
